### [Vulnerability triage, driven by data](triage-en.qmd) {.demo-card-title}

Prioritising by severity is the de facto standard. This analysis brings the likelihood of attack
into the picture, so technical debt can be read as risk. It cross-references 373,000 CVEs with
exploitation probability, confirmed exploitation and attack techniques, ending in a usable
prioritisation rubric.

### [Virstat: sports video analysis](virstat-en.qmd) {.demo-card-title}

Detecting and tracing trajectories over real plays: penalties, field goals, three-pointers and
softball. Six short clips showing frame-by-frame tracking over broadcast video. I built a library
to generate clips quickly, to improve replays in television environments, along with real-time
plotting and video mapping over live signals.
